sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding new stainless pump shaft sh-220: award one of two suppliers.
We hold a competing offer at 16.00 EUR per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:

Please find our cost breakdown attached.
Back to the machines now.
Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
